text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I will run in as many races and seize as
many
victories as I possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: For that is what I must do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
